solutions.title: Basic backtracking
solutions.strategy: Try every next number greater than the previous one until the path reaches length k.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are C(n,k) combinations and each stored result copies k numbers.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output stores every combination; the recursion path adds O(k).

solutions.title: Pruned backtracking
solutions.strategy: Stop loop choices that cannot leave enough numbers to fill the remaining slots.

timeComplexity.explanation: The same C(n,k) results must be emitted and copied.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output dominates; the path and stack use O(k).
